versions.changelog: - Support the use of environment variables to set user information and encryption configurations.
- No changes detected in this release; content remains the same as the previous version.

Initial release of Bark Push Skill.

- Provides intelligent Bark message push assistant with multi-user management and content recognition.
- Supports push history tracking, message updates, and deletion.
- Flexible parameter configuration via JSON; user aliases and grouping supported.
- Offers clear feedback on push operations (success, failure, errors).
- Command-line tool with rich options for titles, subtitles, message types, and advanced actions.
- Thorough documentation and usage examples included.
